The Sleeping Beauty and other Fairy Tales

Certainly the translations, when finished, did not satisfy me, and so I turned back to the beginning and have rewritten the stories in my own way, which (as you may say with the Irish butler) “may not be the best claret, but ’tis the best ye’ve got.”

—

The Sleeping Beauty and other Fairy Tales

From the Old French

Sir Arthur Quiller-Couch

Quiller-Couch’s selection of four children’s stories from the 
Cabinet des Fées,
 the French collection spanning over forty volumes. What began as a strict translation became a “retelling” of these classic fairy tales.
